description: An llm_judge grader whose output couldn't be parsed into a verdict (e.g. the judge model returned unstructured text instead of the expected format) MUST be represented as score: null, passed: false -- per Validation Rule 6, this is a distinct state from a scored failure (a numeric score below threshold). A conformance implementation must accept this document as spec-valid, and downstream tooling that computes pass rates or aggregate statistics from a ResultSet like this must exclude the null-scored grader_result from the denominator rather than counting it as a verified 0/1 failure. Derived from a real case in llamaindex-openeval-adapter: llama_index's EvaluationResult.invalid_result=True (the judge's output couldn't be parsed) maps to exactly this shape, distinct from invalid_result=False, score=0.0 (the judge parsed fine and said 'no').

results.actual_output: The answer is somewhere in the retrieved context.

grader_results.reason: Judge output could not be parsed into YES/NO/UNSURE -- not a scored verdict, no verdict was produced.
